clue.text: One in west coast city selling aromatic shrub

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles, the city on America's west coast
with 'One' it reads as one selling, a vender (variant spelling of vendor)

explanation.surface: A Californian trader is hawking some fragrant garden plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One in west coast city selling' is read as a trader based in Los Angeles; vender is an accepted spelling of vendor.
explanation.definitionFit: The plant is a Mediterranean bush grown for its scented purple flowers and oil.

clue.text: A puzzle to flabbergast

parts.note: a maze is a puzzle of winding paths

explanation.surface: A brainteaser so hard it leaves you astonished.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean to astonish someone completely, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Venus? All the more in grand celebrity

parts.note: 'even more' = all the more, so even stands for it
G is slang shorthand for a grand, a thousand
a star is a famous person

explanation.surface: Is the goddess of love grander still among the famous?
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark signals that Venus is an example: the planet seen brightly after sunset.
explanation.definitionFit: The planet Venus is called this when it shines in the west after sunset.

clue.text: Who draws grid seen in a new light?

indicators.note: seeing letters in a new light suggests rearranging them

explanation.surface: Which artist produced the crossword grid, viewed from a fresh angle?
explanation.definitionFit: A person who draws plans, patterns or layouts professionally; even a crossword's grid has one.

clue.text: A high achiever, I launch far-reaching studies

definitions.meaning: colloquially, a brilliant person; 'it's not exactly ...' means it's easy
a cryptic self-description of someone who studies how to launch craft to space

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is idiom for a genius and literally names a space-propulsion researcher.

clue.text: Draw small sailing boat

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a ketch is a two-masted sailing vessel

explanation.surface: An instruction to depict a little yacht.
explanation.definitionFit: To make a quick rough drawing; a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Box with gratitude in old city

parts.note: to box is to spar, practise punching
TA is informal British for thank you

explanation.surface: A boxer bouts gratefully in an ancient town.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek city-state famed for its warriors.

clue.text: Tree found between hostel and monastery

indicators.note: the tree sits between the two words, so the tail of the first is taken
joins the second word on, whose opening letter follows straight after

explanation.surface: A tree growing in the grounds between a youth hostel and a monastery.
explanation.walkthrough: The tree spans the end of 'hostel' and the start of 'monastery'; 'and' is skipped, so this is a telescoped hidden word.
explanation.definitionFit: A common broadleaf deciduous tree, once widespread in English hedgerows.

clue.text: Conned, we hear, following prisoner's squeeze

indicators.note: the sound comes after the prisoner piece in the answer

parts.note: a con is a convict; with the 's it gives CONS

indicators.note: signals that the word for conned is taken by its sound

parts.note: conned means tricked

explanation.surface: A convict, cheated, is squeezed, so it is said.
explanation.definitionFit: To constrict is to compress or tighten around something.

clue.text: Son with worries first for pets

indicators.note: the worries piece goes in front of the son piece

parts.note: cares are worries

explanation.surface: A boy whose anxieties come before his animals.
explanation.definitionFit: To pet is to stroke lovingly, as does a caress; both verbs here.

clue.text: Following innovation claim one source of fuel

indicators.note: innovation implies making something new, so the letters are remade

explanation.surface: After a new invention, someone patents an energy supply.
explanation.definitionFit: A pit from which a fossil fuel is dug is literally an energy source.

clue.text: Shown back I find a small food shop

indicators.note: the word for shown is read backwards

parts.note: shown the way means led

explanation.surface: Looking behind me, I come across a little grocery.
explanation.definitionFit: A delicatessen, shortened, a shop selling prepared foods.

clue.text: Invitee and one chum give a rough idea

parts.note: a guest is someone invited
I is the Roman numeral for one
mate is a British word for friend

explanation.surface: A party guest and a pal offer a ballpark figure.
explanation.definitionFit: A blend of guess and estimate: an approximate calculation.

clue.text: Small cut in fast food

parts.note: minute means tiny
a steak is a cut of meat

explanation.surface: A tiny slice of something in a takeaway.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin slice of beef that cooks in about sixty seconds, so it is quickly made.

clue.text: Comical gagster succeeded with rolls

indicators.note: something comical is crazy and jumbled, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: S stands for succeeded in genealogies

explanation.surface: A funny comedian did well and had the audience rolling.
explanation.definitionFit: To lurch or reel is to roll unsteadily, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Return batch work in unsatisfactory state

indicators.note: letters in an unsatisfactory state are disordered

explanation.surface: Send back a set of jobs that was badly done.
explanation.definitionFit: A reversion to an earlier type, a return to the past.

clue.text: Catch infection finally — bother

indicators.note: takes the last letter of the word infection

parts.note: to ail is to trouble or bother

explanation.surface: Catching a bug in the end is a nuisance.
explanation.definitionFit: To nail a culprit is to catch them, an informal sense.

clue.text: Be very eager stirring such as a Frappuccino

indicators.note: stirring mixes up the letters of the following word

explanation.surface: Getting excited while mixing a coffee drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A Frappuccino is a branded iced coffee, an example of a drink.

clue.text: Very dry bishop with a dull manner hard to shrug off

parts.note: B is the chess notation for bishop

parts.words: a dull manner hard to shrug off
parts.note: a rut is a boring routine one finds it difficult to escape

explanation.surface: A bishop of tedious habits that he cannot shake.
explanation.definitionFit: The label on champagne for the driest style.

clue.text: One daughter being a character

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
an entity is a being

explanation.surface: A single daughter becomes a personality.
explanation.definitionFit: One's essential nature or self, what makes a person distinct.

clue.text: One contracts standards of perfection

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
deals are agreements or contracts

explanation.surface: A party signing contracts sets the bar for excellence.
explanation.definitionFit: Models or principles of the best possible kind.

clue.text: Foolishly send coward to this entertainment!

indicators.note: acting foolishly means in disorder, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Daftly packing a timid soul off to a dance show!
explanation.walkthrough: The exclamation mark hints the clue half-describes the dance itself, done over crossed blades, which a coward might fear.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish Highland dance performed over crossed blades, a performance.

clue.text: Wine can destroy 50s dress

definitions.meaning: a fortified white wine from Spain, as Falstaff drank
a loose unwaisted dress fashionable in the 1950s

explanation.definitionFit: The word has three senses: an old sherry-like drink, pillage, and a shapeless frock.

clue.text: Central heating container is to boil

parts.note: CH is the abbreviation for central heating, used in property ads
an urn is a vessel

explanation.surface: The radiator system's tank is starting to seethe.
explanation.definitionFit: To churn is to seethe and froth, like boiling water.

clue.text: Sliced beef done with jam intrigues at first

parts.note: something done is over, past
to ram is to cram or jam in

indicators.note: takes the opening letter of intrigues

explanation.surface: Thin beef slices, finished off with preserves, are tempting.
explanation.definitionFit: A seasoned smoked cured beef usually served thinly cut in sandwiches.

clue.text: Little 'un to toddle those first three steps

indicators.note: takes the opening three letters of the words to toddle

explanation.surface: A small child learning to walk its first few paces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'steps' completes the picture of a toddler's first steps.
explanation.definitionFit: A toddler or small child, informally.

clue.text: Approach a rendezvous

parts.note: a rendezvous is a meeting place, a venue

explanation.surface: Getting close to a meeting point.
explanation.definitionFit: A way in, as an avenue of approach to a house or problem.

clue.text: Sort of reggae group backing Tropical Rays

parts.note: ska is a Jamaican music style, forerunner of reggae

indicators.note: the word for group is read backwards

parts.note: a set is a group

explanation.surface: A Jamaican band supporting a band called Tropical Rays.
explanation.definitionFit: Flat-bodied fish of the ray family, found in seas warm and cold.

clue.text: Reportedly quaint monarch is making fine adjustments

indicators.note: what is reported is heard, so the phrase is taken by its sound

parts.note: twee means quaint, cutesy; a king is a monarch

explanation.surface: A rumoured old-fashioned king is fiddling with details.
explanation.definitionFit: To tweak is to adjust slightly, here in the continuous form.
